set.pl: R. S. Bennett 120, sec 27 T89N R25W (Cass Twp), house mark on the 1896 Hamilton atlas, directly N of the County Poor Farm in sec 34; about 3 mi NE of Webster City.
pinev: 1896 Atlas of Hamilton Co, Plat of Cass: 'R. S. Bennett 120', a N-S strip in sec 27 W of centre with a house dot, directly N of 'Hamilton County Poor Farm 160' in sec 34, matching the papers ('next to the county poor farm'). BLM PLSS sec 27 = 42.486-42.501, -93.794 to -93.774.
set.t: Bennett's house was on the 120 in sec 27 just north of the poor farm. The papers' 800 acres may include other land not yet placed. Access: private.

src: Atlas of Hamilton County, Iowa, 1896, Plat of Cass (Ancestry U.S. Indexed County Land Ownership Maps, PC (b))

tw-mi-niles-andrew-jackson-gold.t: 1914 Sanborn sheet 12 has dwellings on three corners: SW 798 Ferry, NW 707 Ferry, NE 801 Ferry. The SE corner was vacant. A Niles directory is needed to tell which house was his.
src: Sanborn Fire Insurance Map, Niles MI, 1914, sheet 12 (LoC)
